name: Neuquenornis
sum: Avisaurid enantiornithean from the Santonian Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Patagonia, Argentina.
wsnote: Length 23.5 cm, hip height 17 cm and mass 205 g estimated from the holotype (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: MUCPv-142, a skull and partial postcranial skeleton.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Chiappe and Calvo 1994

sources.text: Chiappe, Luis M.; Calvo, Jorge O. 1994. Neuquenornis volans, a New Late Cretaceous Bird (Enantiornithes: Avisauridae) from Patagonia, Argentina. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 14(2): 230–246. doi:10.1080/02724634.1994.10011554
